tonight.headline: Tuten is still in your lineup — start Jonathan Taylor
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten is ruled out (ankle/foot) and is still in your RB slot at 06:50 CDMX. ESPN has now zeroed him, so the lineup as set projects 112.0. Boswell finished with 10 in Pittsburgh's 27-5 win, so Golden, Pickens, the Rams and Boswell are all final: 36.6 banked against JuiceJam's 65.6. ESPN gives you 16%.

One move, before 12:00 Sunday: Jonathan Taylor from the bench into Tuten's RB slot. It is worth 14.0 points. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is now a free agent projecting 15.7, which is 1.7 over Taylor, a coin flip. The only seat you could drop is the one you filled on Wednesday, so this brief holds.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam have Gibbs' 48.2 banked, with Stroud (20.5), Collins (15.3), Pollard (14.3) and Croskey-Merritt (11.5) to come. With the swap made, ESPN reads roughly 112 to 144.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Baltimore start Jacoby Brissett against Stroud and Collins, and Houston are favourites (Houston Press 27 Nov), so that is no soft spot. McConkey is on their bench, behind Uiagalelei's first start (Yahoo).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Daniels against Arizona, who allow the most QB points and start Josh Johnson for a second week (NFL.com roundup). You need about 30 over projection from five Sunday players.

case.body: Jacksonville ruled Tuten out (ankle/foot) on Friday after three missed practices (NFL.com Week 12 report; CBS 27 Nov 22:11Z). ESPN has now zeroed his projection.

case.label: The move
case.body: Jonathan Taylor (14.0, IND vs NYG, Sun 12:00) goes into the RB slot. Aaron Jones Sr. (10.3) is 3.7 behind, which is not a coin flip. Taylor is on the screen's exposure list: Seth McGowan is out (NFL.com Week 12), so his share can only grow.

case.label: Who is under centre
case.body: Anthony Richardson was named the starter after the Colts released Daniel Jones (CBS 25 Nov). In 2024 Taylor ran 4.8 a carry in Richardson's 10 starts. CBS says the current line and receivers are weaker, so that is context, not an upgrade.

worthALook.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
worthALook.lead: Friday's condition fired: ESPN repriced him to 15.7. The add is held because the only seat to drop changed hands on Wednesday.

case.label: The player
case.body: 'Slated to operate as the Jaguars' top backfield option' with Tuten out (CBS 27 Nov 22:11Z). Tennessee have allowed 40+ points in three straight games and rank 25th in rushing yards allowed (CBS). He is a free agent, so the add costs no priority.

case.label: Why not today
case.body: 15.7 against Taylor's and Gordon's 14.0 is 1.7, inside the coin-flip line. The only droppable seat is Aaron Jones Sr., added Wednesday 25 Nov at 18:31Z. STRATEGY §3 closes a slot that changed hands in the last seven days unless the player in it is ruled out, and Jones is healthy. Rice, Odunze and Jacobs are locked.

case.label: Where yesterday's brief disagrees
case.body: Friday's condition read: 'ESPN reprices him above 14.0, then add and drop Aaron Jones Sr.' It fired. I take the churn rule over it, because STRATEGY outranks a per-run trigger and the edge is a coin flip. If you would rather have Tuten's handcuff for Weeks 13-14, that is a defensible free move. Do it before Sunday 12:00.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jacksonville say Tuten will miss Week 13 at Chicago, or Rodriguez takes 18+ carries Sunday. Then add him once the Jones seat reopens (Wed 2 Dec), dropping Aaron Jones Sr.
